services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: For years, the Dolly Steamboat has provided a unique setting for private charters for weddings, special parties, corporate events, client entertainment, business meetings, off-site training, and team building cruises. A wedding aboard the Dolly Steamboat is a romantic experience to be cherished throughout your lifetime. You may also include a reception dinner and starlight cruise after the ceremony. Rehearsal dinners, commitment ceremonies and anniversaries all make for elegant affairs on beautiful Canyon Lake, AZ. includes: Air conditioned lower and upper decks
Narration about Superstition Mountains and wildlife
blurb: Guests take cruises on Canyon Lake aboard the Dolly Steamboat to see desert bighorn sheep, bald eagles, and other wildlife. Cruises include scenic nature tours, twilight dinner cruises, astronomy dinner cruises, and special bighorn sheep viewing events. The boat has air conditioned lower and upper decks and offers narration about the Superstition Mountains.
